description: Creates a new Cognigy.AI large language model configuration. LLMs power Knowledge AI, AI Agents, and generative features. Requires a connection with provider credentials. MUTATING: Set dryRun=false to create.

connectionId.description: The connection ID containing the provider credentials

dryRun.description: If true (default), validates without creating. Set to false to actually create.

isDefault.description: Set as the default LLM for the project

modelGroup.description: Model group: 'chat' for conversational, 'completion' for text generation, 'embedding' for embeddings

projectId.description: The project ID to create the LLM in

providerConfig.description: Provider-specific configuration (e.g., resourceName, deploymentName for Azure)

name: create_llm
